name: 48236 · Grosse Pt Frm, MI
findings: ZIP 48236 (Grosse Pt Frm) has 228 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48236 (Grosse Pt Frm) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
